An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''base''' was located on the forest [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. By [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], it was commanded by [[Ozzik Sturn]]. Located in a small canyon area, the base was circled by a cliff and a metal fence. The main part of the complex consisted of a small bunker with two levels. In 2 BBY, [[Galen Marek]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|stormed]] the base and slaughtered most of the Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]] stationed there.
